services.name: Sunset Tours
services.desc: Honestly, the sunset we get are some of the best (if not even the best) in the city. Enjoy stunning mountain views, and fantastic views of the Vancouver skyline, all the while the sky turns orange and the sun sets right into the sea. On this small intimate kayak tour, customers frequently report sightings of harbour seals and our resident bald eagles that soar overhead. The paddle pace is relaxed, ensuring time to take in the views, learn about the history of our area, and stop for photos along the way. services.name: kayak tour
services.desc: Discover why British Columbia is renowned as one of the world’s premier kayaking destinations! If you are wondering what to do in Vancouver, look no further! Whether you’re a local Vancouverite or a tourist exploring the city, kayaking is an essential experience. Jericho Beach Kayak is easily accessible from downtown (20 minutes by bus) as well as from other parts in the city with parking directly available at our location. Our guided kayak tours are some of the best outdoor activities in Vancouver and promise breathtaking views of majestic mountains, the Vancouver skyline, and the charm of local beaches, with opportunities to encounter native wildlife like seals, eagles, and cormorants.
